approvedDesign.prompt: Create a production-oriented character design sheet for an original cozy top-down farming game called Mirror Island. Use reference image 1 ONLY for the approved fresh pastoral art direction and the appealing brown-haired farmer's proportions; reference image 2 ONLY for the compact, cohesive body proportions and readable world-scale silhouette of a Stardew-style farmer. Do not copy any particular Stardew character or the farm scenery. This is an original character art asset study, not a UI mockup, not an illustration of a full world. Draw TWO rows with FOUR evenly spaced full-body standing sprites each: row 1 a young adult male farmer with natural tousled chestnut short hair; row 2 a young adult female farmer with a softly tied chestnut ponytail. Within each row show exactly FRONT, LEFT PROFILE, BACK, RIGHT PROFILE, with strictly matching anatomy, outfit details, height, foot baseline and lighting across directions. No labels or text. Both wear a warm ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, muted blue/teal denim overalls with small brass fasteners and fitted trouser legs, dark brown small work boots. Relaxed arms naturally resting at sides, compact connected shoulders, short neck, clear waist and hips, modest small hands, simple kind eyes and a small rounded jaw. A coherent classic farming RPG pixel sprite silhouette, about 2.6 heads tall, neither a huge baby head nor a tiny head on a long thin body. The hairstyle has organized chunky pixel clusters, irregular tuft contour, no squared helmet, no straight cap brim; faces have warm midtone skin with subtle shadow, no pale triangular mask or moustache-like mouth. Crisp true pixel art, visible consistent square pixel grid, about 24 by 36 logical pixels per full body, minimal strong warm outline, a carefully controlled palette and clean 2-3 shade ramps. Render the pixels enlarged with nearest-neighbor so the sheet is easy to examine; no antialiasing, blur, painterly gradients, plastic 3D or vector style. Large equal gaps between sprites and generous border, entirely flat light warm gray background, no floor, shadows, props, scenery, UI or decorative frames. Highest attention to charming professional sprite anatomy, restrained detail and four-direction coherence. Landscape sheet.

primary.name: male-short-overalls-trousers
primary.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D pixel-art farming-game animation sprite sheet, not a concept illustration.
Input image 1 is the USER-APPROVED identity, anatomy, materials and pixel-cluster style. Preserve the TOP ROW male farmer exactly: warm friendly round face, same large restrained brown eyes, same tousled chestnut hair and hair silhouette, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, teal-blue denim bib overalls with two brass buttons, brown ankle boots. Do not redesign or simplify into stick limbs.
Create ONE sheet of exactly 12 full-body sprites in a strict 3 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced grid, portrait 1024x1536. Each cell contains one same-size character. Row 1 faces DOWN/front; row 2 faces LEFT; row 3 faces RIGHT; row 4 faces UP/back. Columns are: left-foot-forward walking contact, neutral standing idle feet next to each other, right-foot-forward walking contact. All views orthographic, same mild top-down farming RPG viewpoint as reference; no 3/4 angles. Heads face same direction as torso. Walking contact frames show subtle natural opposing arm swing and real alternating legs, no running, no huge lunge. Neutral middle column especially closely matches the approved male.
Keep each sprite's foot baseline exactly same distance from its cell bottom, head-to-feet height and shoulders/waist proportion consistent across every cell. Reserve wide empty gutters, no overlap. Visible figure height roughly 78% of each cell. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, clean dark-brown outline, warm copper hair highlights, readable fabric pockets and fold clusters, coherent daylight from upper left. A modest 48x80 logical-pixel character rendered larger with sharp edges; preserve the attractive reference details and connected anatomy. Gender is young adult male, not a child.
Background truly transparent alpha, no gray/white/checkerboard field baked into the image, no floor or cast shadows. No headings, no captions, no labels, no grid lines, no tools, no extra sprites. Output the clean atlas only.
